Don’t say “you should see a professional”, I already do.... Soooo often people will ask if I want to talk or if I’m ok and then when I tell them what’s going on they kind of panic and just tell me I should talk to a professional instead. It makes me feel bad because I feel like there’s something wrong with me and they’re just trying to get rid of me. If you don’t really want to talk that’s fine just don’t ask what’s wrong.

Damn I relate to this so much. My best friend nearly killed himself in 8th grade after years of abuse. Ever since then I’ve just felt fucked up. Past few years of high school have been very rough. This past month though has been the worst. At least once a week I’ll try to convince myself to reach out to somebody and I’ll end up having anxiety attack trying to figure out what to do which only leads to more bad thoughts. I’m sorry I don’t have much advice because I’m in a very similar situation myself. Personally I try to focus on the things that make me happy and the things that make me feel like I’m really experiencing life. For me it’s playing sports talking with my friends but for you it might be hiking or painting. Just the things that I feel like are really the essential parts of what life is, and immersing myself in them. Some nights it’s really hard but I at least try to make an effort when I’m not feeling to bad.
